title: Portfolio Website
description: Animations for this website were done myself taking advantage of what CSS has to offer instead of using external libraries. Scroll animations are done by calculating an angle depending on scroll position - that angle is then used with CSS' transform, using rotate3d(), translate3d(), and skewY() in order to create the 3d rotation animation used between sections.
extraDetails: Project data is stored in a json file which is used to create the project section programatically. This makes it easy to update later on, without having to update the svelte files
Pixel art was done (by me) in an application called Aseprite. This includes my self-portrait, the pocket with the pen, the animated name gif, and the hand
Paper and Button backgrounds are extendable by size by utilizing CSS' background and border-image along with a single image for each to generate both background border and background
Folder animation is done using CSS' transform and Matrix3D()

title: Kirby Color Selector
descriptionShort: Single-page web application for selecting a highly-customizable color theme
description: This single-page web application helps users create a color theme for a mod for video game. While users can select colors individually, the site includes a lot of options for creating a synergistic color theme, which updates in real-time in the animation. This website is purely HTML, CSS, and JavaScript - no libraries used.
extraDetails: Select between 4 different animations, which updates automatically in the canvas. Animation speed, pixel size, and canvas size can all be manipulated with the canvas
Hover over aech of the ascii codes on the right side to highlight each pixel of that color in the animation canvas
Lock and unlock colors (padlock icons) which will stop those colors from being changed through the sliders and buttons
Select between multiple default themes to work from instead of using the default theme
Sliders allow you to change hue, saturation, and brightness of each group of colors in the animation, as well as all colors
Buttons allow you to randomize colors, hues, reset colors, and remove outlying colors
Includes all the same options for second character with own animation and page theme
Site is generalized to a template allowing it to be easily adapted for use for other games, characters, and animations (a second version of the site for Donkey Kong Country has also been made)
Wrote a Java program to translate animation frames from game into array of colors, which is used in the site to make the animation

title: Crochet Pattern Automator v2
descriptionShort: Website that allows users to create a crochet pattern out of their uploaded image
description: Users can upload a photo to this website and change the settings to make a crochet pattern for a "graphgan". Colors can be selected manually or automatically, using the K-Means clustering algorithm. Users can customize using a wide range of settings, including the number of stitches, rows, size, color values, number of colors, and number of clusters used for the k-means algorithm.
extraDetails: Stitch width to height ratio can be modified with the gauge settings, along with the size of the stitches in inches or centimeters

By clicking the images, the focused version of the image will change. These include estimation of how the project would look, the original image, image with averaged colors per stitch, and image using the clusters form the K-Means algorithm
Colors can be automatically selected based on K-Means, or they can be selected manually
You can define the final project by desired height or width in inches or centimeters, or by number of stitches or rows. The other options will be estimated based on gauge and selected parameter
Background color theme will automatically change depending on image uploaded

title: Crochet Pattern Automator v1
descriptionShort: A previous iteration of the Crochet Pattern Automator, but made with Java in a desktop application.
description: Users can change settings and upload an image for creating a crochet pattern. This app also uses K-Means Clustering algorithm. Along with the pattern instructions, this app also created a simulated image of the final crochet work.

title: Snake (HTML5 game)
descriptionShort: HTML5 game rendition of the classic game, Snake.
description: Users can change number settings, including player count (1 or 2), speed/difficulty, grid size, and snake color. Code was written entirely with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript, which was transpiled automatically to JavaScript for the live page - no other libraries were used.

title: YAML Editor
descriptionShort: Single page site for creating YAML settings files for an application called Archipelago
description: This website allows users create complex yaml files based on a number of settings. Being heavily based in data, this project takes advantage of Svelte's reactiveness with changes to data updating live.

title: Portuguese Verb Practice App
descriptionShort: Android app to help English speakers learn Portuguese verb conjugations, through games and quizzes. Includes a dictionary and an extremely customizable experience.
description: This app allows users to Portuguese practice verb conjugations. It includes over 2000 verbs to practice conjugating using generated wordsearches, crosswords, and quizzes, as well as a searchable dictionary in which the user can view conjugations and create a specific group of verbs to practice. The user can also select verbs from verb endings, conjugation patterns, and irregularities. They can select which verb tenses/moods they want to practice, some of which differ slightly depending on whether they're practicing European Portuguese or Brazilian Portuguese. They can also change the game settings and subject pronouns.

title: Hit or Blow Logic Puzzle App
descriptionShort: A simple logic puzzle with customizable settings, in the form of an Android application. Based on the board game Mastermind which was made in 1970.
description: In this logic puzzle game, the user has a number of guesses to determine the which 4 colors are part of the code, and in which order. The user can change how many colors may appear in the 4-color code, and how many guesses they have. The game is based on the board game Mastermind, which was created in 1970 - the internet phenomenon Wordle was based on this same game.

title: Train Tracks Logic Puzzle App
descriptionShort: An Android app for generating and playing the Train Tracks logic puzzle.
description: In this logic puzzle game, the user has to determine a train's path in an eight-by-eight grid, based solely the start and end of the path along with how many squares of tracks appear in each row and column.

title: Spanish-English Crossword Generator
descriptionShort: A website/PWA for generating bilingual Spanish and English crosswords.
description: In this installable Progressive Web Application, you can generate Spanish-English crossword using more than 5000 words. Includes Spanish and English conjugations for verbs in the Present and Preterite tense. Includes various settings for personalizing the crosswords.
